text: Runs as a self-hosted Docker container with a mounted data directory for persistence
Supports hybrid search that fuses dense and sparse vector results using RRF or DBSF ranking
quote: Qdrant has a few ways of fusing the results from different queries: `rrf` and `dbsf`

text: Query filters can combine AND/OR/NOT logical clauses
quote: Qdrant allows you to combine conditions in clauses. Clauses are different logical operations, such as `OR`, `AND`, and `NOT`.

text: Offers multiple strategies (e.g. payload partitioning) to isolate many tenants inside one collection
quote: Partition by payload filters points by a payload field that identifies the tenant. This is efficient for a large number of small, similarly-sized tenants.

text: Distributed deployment mode shards and replicates data across multiple peer nodes
quote: Qdrant supports a distributed deployment mode. In this mode, multiple Qdrant services communicate with each other to distribute the data across the peers

text: Collection snapshots are tar archives of data/config that can be used for backup and restore
quote: Snapshots are `tar` archive files that contain data and configuration of a specific collection on a specific node at a specific time.

text: Provides Admin, Read-Only, and Granular per-collection scoped API keys
quote: Qdrant supports three types of API key: **Admin API Key**... **Read-Only API Key**... **Granular Access API Keys**

text: Free tier with no token limits and no payment method required
quote: No token limits ... No payment method required

text: Can configure dense, sparse, and multi-vector embeddings and use cloud-hosted embedding models directly
quote: Configure dense, sparse, and multi-vector embeddings. Use cloud-hosted embedding models directly with Qdrant.

text: Qdrant Edge is a lightweight embedded vector search engine for in-process, offline retrieval on devices
quote: Qdrant Edge is a lightweight, embedded vector search engine for in-process retrieval — no background services, minimal memory footprint, and no network required.

text: Provides official client libraries in Go, Rust, JS/TS, Python, .NET/C#, and Java
quote: Go client ... Rust client ... JavaScript/TypeScript client ... Python client ... .NET/C# client ... Java client

text: Ships ready-to-use agent skills that bring vector-search capabilities into AI coding assistants
quote: Qdrant provides a collection of ready-to-use agent skills that bring Qdrant's vector search capabilities directly into your AI coding assistant.

text: Client API lets you create a collection with a configurable vector size and distance metric
Supports API key auth plus network binding, TLS encryption, and audit logging for compliance
quote: Qdrant supports API key authentication ... network binding, TLS for encrypted connections, and audit logging for compliance.

text: Qdrant Private Cloud lets you manage Qdrant clusters on any Kubernetes infrastructure
quote: Qdrant Private Cloud allows you to manage Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure.

text: Deployable on any infrastructure with documented configuration options and GPU setup guides
quote: Deploy Qdrant on any infrastructure. Get requirements, configuration options, and GPU setup guides.

text: Provides a production-ready API to store, search, and manage vector points with payload metadata
quote: It provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage points—vectors with an additional payload.
